mapper.sql: a.incident_id, a.capture_id, a.assignee_user_id, a.assigned_at, a.assigned_by, a.version, u.username AS assignee_username, u.display_name AS assignee_display_name, u.enabled AS assignee_enabled
mapper.select: SELECT FROM incident_assignments a LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.assignee_user_id WHERE a.incident_id = #{incidentId}
SELECT FROM incident_assignments a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.assignee_user_id WHERE a.incident_id IN #{iid}

SELECT a.incident_id, a.capture_id, a.assignee_user_id, a.assigned_at, a.assigned_by, a.version FROM incident_assignments a WHERE a.assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL
AND a.assignee_user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO incident_assignments (incident_id, capture_id, assignee_user_id, assigned_at, assigned_by, version) VALUES (#{incidentId}, #{captureId}, #{assigneeUserId}, #{assignedAt}, #{assignedBy}, 1) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE incident_assignments SET assignee_user_id = #{assigneeUserId}, assigned_at = #{assignedAt}, assigned_by = #{assignedBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.incident_id, h.capture_id, h.job_id, h.from_user_id, h.to_user_id, fu.username AS from_username, tu.username AS to_username, h.actor_username, h.reason, h.changed_at FROM incident_assignment_history h LEFT JOIN users fu ON fu.id = h.from_user_id LEFT JOIN users tu ON tu.id = h.to_user_id WHERE h.incident_id = #{incidentId} ORDER BY h.changed_at DESC, h.id DESC
